name: anhurdb-memory
description: Give Claude Code a persistent, sovereign long-term memory backed by AnhurDB: auto-recall at session start, incremental auto-persist every turn and at session end, with a no-silent-loss disk queue and retry. A background monitor surfaces a memory that stops saving, and three skills (memory-health, memory-blackout, memory-recall) diagnose and read it on demand. Also bundles the AnhurDB MCP tools.
